details: Whitespace-normalized duplicate text: all affected rows; retained for document provenance, not deduplicated.
Allowed: six structural actions; blank only for unreviewed/API-failure rows
Excluded non-legal actions must not be in clean CSV; blank actions must not imply completion
Identity checked against original V3, not only ID prefix
No text edits or physical merge/split allowed
Source must match the actual V3 file
Exact retained-ID reconciliation against source reviews
Blank when unknown; otherwise finite number in [0, 1]
If populated: JSON list of distinct exact category names; scalar accepted only in a single-label column
Assignments need label_verified=true, label_source, and label_reviewer
Verified clause-level category assignments; structural actions are not labels
Verified clauses assigned more than one category; parser capability is not annotated data
